analysis_result.analysis: The model's reasoning fails at multiple levels. First, it misperceives the initial cube face colors, assigning them incorrectly. Second, it fundamentally misinterprets the cube's path — assuming a 2D grid movement with only 4 rolls instead of the correct 5-roll linear path (Right, Backward, Backward, Right, Backward). This leads to incorrect kinematic tracking of the top face. The combination of wrong initial state and wrong movement sequence causes the model to arrive at a completely incorrect final top face (green instead of orange). The error is systemic and cascading, rooted in misperception and flawed physical simulation.
